meta.method: Display only: subtract mapped park and open-space polygons, retaining holes and disconnected land. Fully covered cells omitted. H3 ids and matching evidence stay in area_cells.geojson.
meta.limitations: Mapped parks are not a parcel-level residential land-use inventory; boundaries and completeness inherit the source data.
meta.regional_extension: Legacy fields describe the original extract; see regional_coverage.json and manifest regional_study for extended source coverage and dates.
